Timothy — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the launch spike. We're glad it's getting traction.

High-level proposal we can execute today to keep the service stable and avoid surprise billing:
- Provisional shortfall bridge: grant a temporary 50% headroom increase for 10 days to cover immediate traffic.
- Staged rebate/settlement: we offset overrun units above your committed baseline with a graduated rebate (40% rebate on the first 20% overrun, 20% rebate on the next 30%). Remaining overrun billed at standard overrun rate.
- Commitment window: we ask for a signed short-term addendum to formalize the bridge and reconciliation cadence.

Can you confirm whether you want the headroom to apply account-wide or scoped to the Demo environment only? I attached a one-page provisional addendum and a simple usage runbook showing how we'll meter the reconciliation.

If that works, Marissa will prepare the addendum for signature, and Ben will coordinate billing reconciliation. We can turn the headroom on immediately after you confirm scope.
